headline: Harding lose an eighth match, still without a win
dek: Harding have played eight matches and lost all eight, with no win and no draw to set against them. Fort Hays State were the latest side to beat them, and no programme in the division has lost as often.
displaced_by: results night: Harding's eighth defeat in eight matches, more than any programme in the division
